description: This is a shell script that tests interaction with Perforce (P4) involving case-folding, including creating repositories, adding files, and cloning repositories with different case sensitivities.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for necessary prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts Perforce server with specific options.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets the client view in Perforce workspace.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a Git repository.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
